1556. Minimum Prepended Chars for Palindrome

80

Hard

Problem Statement:
Given a string S, find the minimum number of characters that need to be added to the front of S to make it a palindrome. You are required to use the Knuth-Morris-Pratt (KMP) algorithm or its concepts to solve this problem efficiently.
input_spec: A single line containing the string S.
output_spec: A single integer representing the minimum number of characters to be added to the front of S to make it a palindrome.
